subject.title: [Feature]: Memory/Context Improvements (metrics + global semantic search + conversation chaining + preload on restart)

question: Should this issue remain the canonical umbrella, and which remaining metrics, continuity, and restart-preload contracts belong in core rather than a memory plugin?
rationale: The remaining work requires explicit choices about privacy scope, defaults, telemetry semantics, cost, and Gateway lifecycle ordering that source inspection cannot safely resolve.

options.title: Keep and split
options.body: Retain this issue as the umbrella and designate narrow issues for agent metrics, normal-session handoff, and restart preload with explicit security contracts.

options.title: Delegate optional memory
options.body: Keep only missing generic hooks in core and route automatic user modeling, transcript-recall policy, and enrichment to memory plugins.

options.title: Close after reassignment
options.body: Close this umbrella only after every meaningful remainder has one clearly designated canonical issue and owner boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep and split
recommendation.body: Retain this issue as the umbrella and designate narrow issues for agent metrics, normal-session handoff, and restart preload with explicit security contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history and prior review span the broadest combination of memory, usage, startup, and session surfaces needed for this decision.
